messages:
sarah_cs: Kicking off FathomAI dedicated bring-up this week. Need a concrete quota plan + autoscale thresholds. They requested steady 400 requests/minute with short bursts up to ~1200rpm for 10-15m. Who can own quota bump and the surge test?
alex_sre: I can own the autoscale policy config. Need traffic profile (p50/p95 lat targets) and whether KV/prefix caching will be enabled. @diego_eng can you share the load script?
diego_eng: Quick note: model is rdx-3b-v2 (KV cache enabled). Suggested latency SLO p95 <= 250ms. Load script (k6) snippet below, run shadow first then ramp:
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://redwood-infer.example/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({model: 'rdx-3b-v2', prompt: 'summarize: ...'}), {headers: {'Authorization': 'Bearer $TOKEN'}});
}
```
I'll push the full script to the repo and point to S3 artifact. Schedule: shadow 60m (no traffic shaping), then ramp 30m to 1200rpm.
mina_se: Customer requested a 30m enablement session and a canary window (2 hours) after the shadow run. I'll own the enablement deck + checklist. Also, will collect initial feedback in #cs-feedback.
tammy_acct: FYI finance: bursts > baseline may change effective unit cost; we should confirm committed quota vs burst billing. If we need temp extra quota this month, I can queue it with billing ops.
capacity_bot: Dedicated pool allocation request submitted (REQ-4321). ETA for allocation approval: ~4 hours.
alex_sre: Proposed autoscale policy (draft):
```
min_instances: 1
max_instances: 12
scale_metric: cpu_util
target_utilization: 70
scale_up_cooldown_s: 60
scale_down_cooldown_s: 300
burst_headroom_tokens: 0.15  # keep some headroom for tail latency
```
We'll also enable model-variant fallback to rdx-3b-quant when GPU contention > 80% to protect p95.
diego_eng: For the load test let's add a KV cache priming step: 10k prefixes at low QPS for 15m so cold misses are minimized. Also logging config: sampling at 1% to avoid overload.
sarah_cs: Owners + timeline check: sarah_cs (CS lead), alex_sre (ops), diego_eng (eng), mina_se (enablement), tammy_acct (billing). Target: shadow + enablement Wed 10:00-13:00, ramp & canary Wed 14:00-16:00, go/no-go Thu EOD. :white_check_mark:
mina_se: I booked the enablement slot and sent calendar invites to the customer. I'll attach onboarding doc and capture the checklist in the thread.
tammy_acct: Marked renewal risk in CRM as 'elevated' until performance verified. I'll update after canary.
sarah_cs: Thanks — please post final runbook + link to load artifacts here when ready. :rocket:
